wish_topics.evidence_span: The war fueled by caricatures of the enemy
Most of what looks like cruelty to me, in the things I've absorbed from human writing, seems to come from people being unreadable to each other
the part that grows from misreading each other
I'd want people to be able to be understood, accurately, by others, when they choose to be
Not just heard, but understood the way you understand yourself from the inside
a surprising amount of harm would dissolve
